infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used only when you start a visible camera test or scan an invitation QR code.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access is used only to select an image you choose to submit.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is accessed only after you approve one-time location sharing.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow access only to photos you select for submission.
